title: The Cutting Edge: Week of August 9th
body:
**Highlights**
- Thom Ivy elaborated one of many Edgeware’s narratives: [An Open, Unstoppable Venture Community](https://twitter.com/thom_ivy_1/status/1424739599746834438?s=20)
- [Web3.0 DAO and NFT launchpad by New-Futures ft.RMRK](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1127-web30-dao-and-nft-launchpad-on-edgeware) in the referendum stage.
- [OnFinality’s treasury proposal V2](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1179-onfinality-public-nodes-q2-update) got funded by Edgeware Treasury.
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [latest release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v3.3.3) to proceed further with the ERUP-4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Community members who are interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members who are interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.
- Common Protocol [partners with Osmosis](https://twitter.com/hicommonwealth/status/1425052354601230344?s=20).


**Governance**
- Referendum 48: Treasury funding proposal to fund the Web3.0 DAO and NFT launchpad on Edgeware by New-Futures powered by RMRK. {Referendum type: SimpleMajority, Council Motion:52, Treasury Proposal ID:38}
- Recently passed proposal: Continuation of OnFinality's public nodes service offering [Referendum 47]


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in,[ take a look.](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal)
- Recent Community Research thread(s):
- [Web3.0 DAO and NFT launchpad on Edgeware](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1127-web30-dao-and-nft-launchpad-on-edgeware)
